prospective_rules.rule: A mature deprecation removal or configuration-container refactor may accept when a repository-wide old-symbol inventory reaches zero, every production call site has an explicit replacement, import/compile succeeds, and affected existing tests are updated; distributed topology is not required when runtime algorithms and state layout are unchanged.
